raw_text: Third Pakistani drone shot down on Punjab border this week. This one had 5kg of heroin. BSF is doing good work but the drones keep coming. The narco-terror nexus from Kasur district in Pakistan is clearly well-funded. India needs better anti-drone tech along the entire Punjab border. These hexacopters are cheap and easy to replace.
